title: Zonaras
summary: Raleigh names Zonaras in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Zonaras, the chronicler he cites for Hiram, for Tabremmon, and for Pekahiah. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. II, sig. 233b–234a
